description: Spawn parallel specialized subagents to analyze a user's reasoning from multiple angles: conceptual clarity, assumption identification, logical consistency, knowledge gaps, analogical reasoning, meta-cognitive awareness. Each lens produces structured findings; a merger synthesizes; a judge produces a final verdict. Pattern directly from Storybloq's review-lenses system adapted for cognitive analysis instead of code review. Enables deeper havruta engagement than a single-perspective response.
title: Multi-lens reasoning analysis — parallel specialized agents
